findings.title: Wait can succeed on the previously deployed revision
findings.body: The plan waits for merge and then only for ArgoCD health. An Application can remain Healthy while the requested merge is still OutOfSync, so this poll can terminate immediately on the pre-merge deployment. Thisrepository already treats health without revision binding as unsafe in tools/activate-app.ts. The CLI would tell humans and agents that a new image, secret, or resource is deployed when it is not.
findings.code:
- 대기 시맨틱: 기본 = run 완료 + 산출 PR URL 출력. --wait = auto-merge 완료(required check
  gate 단일 — ADR 0003) 후 ArgoCD healthy까지. KUBECONFIG 부재 시 --wait는 머지까지 확인하고
  라이브 구간 생략을 명시한다. 폴링 간격·데드라인은 주입 가능(테스트 심).
findings.recommendation: Record the PR merge SHA and require Synced plus an observed sync revision equal to or descending from that SHA before accepting Healthy. Specify timeout and later-main behavior, and test a stale-Healthy/OutOfSync fixture.

findings.title: Run discovery can attach to another caller's mutation
findings.body: A workflow, event type, and time window do not uniquely identify a dispatch. Concurrent CLI or MCP calls, or a retry after an uncertain dispatch response, can produce multiple matching runs before workflowconcurrency serializes their execution. Following the wrong run can report another mutation's PR or success while this request failed. The existing race exit code does not help unless ambiguity is explicitly detected.
findings.code:
- run 특정·추적: workflow_dispatch는 run id를 돌려주지 않으므로, 디스패치 직후 해당 워크플로의
  run 목록을 짧게 폴링해 자기 run을 특정한다(디스패치 시각 창 + 이벤트 타입 필터). 추적은 run
  conclusion까지가 기본이고, 실패 시 실패 잡 이름과 run URL을 보고한다.
findings.recommendation: Define a provable correlation protocol, such as a request ID carried into run-name, even if that requires revising the dispatcher-contract scope. Otherwise require exactly one candidate and fail closedwith exit 3. Test simultaneous dispatches and retry-after-timeout.

findings.title: Open question: how does wait behave for manual-merge mutations?
findings.body: The blanket wait definition requires auto-merge, while teardown explicitly forbids it and the existing create-app workflow also requires manual merge because merge is first-deployment and exposure approval. Animplementer must either wait forever, reject --wait, or weaken an existing human approval boundary. The plan does not choose among them.
findings.code:
- teardown confirm 가드: --confirm <앱이름> 플래그가 디스패처의 confirm 입력으로 전달된다.
  플래그 부재 시 TTY면 재입력 프롬프트, 비-TTY면 거부. auto-merge를 켜는 어떤 경로도 두지 않는다
  (머지는 수동 = 기존파괴 경계 정책).
findings.recommendation: Add a per-command wait matrix. For create-app and teardown, preserve manual approval and define whether --wait observes an externally performed merge, returns a bounded pending result, or is rejected.Test each policy explicitly.

findings.title: Open question: how is app init resumed after partial failure?
findings.body: The first step creates durable remote state, followed by several fallible local and remote operations. A clone, scaffold, commit, push, or one-of-two secret-setting failure leaves a repository that the literalretry path can no longer create, with no checkpoint, ownership proof, cleanup rule, or resume semantics. The promised one-command flow can therefore strand the first onboarding attempt.
findings.code:
- app init 체인: 템플릿 레포에서 새 레포 생성(기본 private, --public 옵트인) → 클론 →
  스캐폴더 비대화형 실행(--archetype fullstack|api|site|worker — kind는 아키타입 유도값, CONTEXT.md
  용어) → 커밋 → 첫push. --dispatch-secrets 지정 시에만 App 키 경로를 받아 새 레포에 디스패치
  시크릿 쌍을 설정한다(기본 미배선 = 크론 백스톱).
findings.recommendation: Specify preflight-before-create, checkpointed/idempotent retry behavior, safe recognition of a repository created by this invocation, and explicit cleanup guidance. Fault-inject every boundary,including failure after setting only one dispatch secret.

findings.title: Open question: what blocks release on the external template fix?
findings.body: The plan acknowledges that the template currently emits an arm64-hardcoded target while the required host is amd64, but places the fix outside this branch's gate without declaring it a release prerequisite. TheCLI can therefore pass its own gate and create an app that predictably fails with an exec-format error. Consuming a mutable external template also leaves later scaffold-contract version skew unaddressed.
findings.code:
- 크로스레포 티켓 — 템플릿 arm64 수리: 템플릿 아키타입들의 빌드 대상 하드코딩(bun-linux-arm64)을
  TARGETARCH 파라미터화로 수리한다(선행 수정된 기존 앱 2곳과 같은 방식). 이 작업은 템플릿 레포에서
  수행되며homelab 브랜치 게이트 범위 밖임을 명시한다.
findings.recommendation: Make the template ticket a blocking dependency, identify a compatible template ref or explicit scaffold contract version, have doctor reject incompatible versions, and require amd64 plus multiarchscaffold/build/smoke evidence before this feature is accepted.

findings.title: Open question: what exactly is the stable JSON contract?
findings.body: Only three illustrative top-level concepts are named. There is no schema version, command-specific result shape, error envelope, timeout or pending representation, skipped-live-state representation, or rulemapping stdout to exit codes. Different tickets can implement mutually incompatible objects while each satisfies this prose, and the stated tests have no concrete stable contract to assert.
findings.code:
- --json 계약: 전 동사가 안정된 최상위 형태(성공 여부·동사·결과 오브젝트: run URL·PR URL·상태
  등)를 출력한다. MCP tool 결과도 같은 오브젝트를 재사용한다(계약 한 벌).
- 종료코드: 기존 도구 규약(0=성공 · 1=검증/게이트 실패 · 2=사용법 오류 · 3=race · 4=skip +
  SKIP 마커) 준수.
findings.recommendation: Commit a versioned JSON Schema or discriminated TypeScript contract covering every verb and every success, error, skip, race, pending, and timeout state. Define stdout/stderr and exit-code mapping, thentest serialized fixtures for CLI and MCP.

findings.title: Open question: what is the MCP operation and workspace model?
findings.body: The server promises short calls and later status polling but defines neither an operation handle nor durable background execution. app init has no deployment status to poll before registration, and app secretsdepends on the caller's repository directory while a stdio server has one fixed working directory. An implementation must guess whether to block, orphan background work, or silently select dispatch-only mode; concurrentcalls also cannot be tied back to their initiating tool call.
findings.code:
- MCP 서버 모드: stdio transport. 노출 = 파괴 제외 전부(app init/create/secrets, db create/url,
  cache create/url, status, doctor). teardown은 CLI 전용. tool 호출은 짧게 —
  긴 대기는 하지 않고 status 재호출을안내한다.
findings.recommendation: Define explicit workspace or destination inputs and a per-tool synchronization boundary. Either return a correlated run or durable operation ID with an operation-status contract, or keep local multi-step verbs out of MCP until that lifecycle exists. Test server restart and concurrent calls.

next_steps: Revise the plan with a correlated dispatch state machine and merge-SHA-bound ArgoCD readiness.
Specify per-verb manual versus automatic merge behavior and recoverable app-init phases.
Add concrete JSON and MCP schemas, then make the compatible template fix and amd64 smoke evidence release blockers.
